description.value: Clancy's Meat Co. is a family-owned specialty butcher and prepared-foods shop established in 1997, with its Chilliwack location at 45800 Promontory Rd on Promontory Heights. The shop carries fresh and frozen meats, locally sourced BC products, and ready-to-eat meals prepared fresh daily — a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists looking for high-quality provisions. Staff are known for hands-on food knowledge, offering cooking tips and cut recommendations.
